remarks: Welcome to 4261 Lake Shore Road; the modern luxury Mansion at Lakecrest with impeccable finishes, magnificently set on Lake Erie with gorgeous views of the City of Buffalo skyline, Canada across the expanse, and preeminent sunsets with painted skies. With over 330 feet of deeded waterfront access, this stately Georgian Colonial was reconstructed and augmented to 5,294 square feet in the early 1970s, creating sweeping and serene water views. Step in from the incredible pillared front terrace, to the generous front foyer with a grand staircase with wrought iron railings, the formal living room with gas fireplace & custom mantle around to the dining room & immense sunroom adorned with windows for an abundance of natural light, graced with Brazilian Cherry hardwood flooring and ornate crown molding throughout. Elegance doesn’t capture the grandeur of the four attractive bedrooms upstairs, three of which have ensuite bathrooms, with no expense spared on gold plated exquisite fixtures and complete with accents that incorporate the 20th century charm of yesteryear, two walk-in closets, and ample storage. Currently operating as a primary home residence and active Bed & Breakfast, the second stairwell makes for ease of living while the elegant gated driveway & hedgerow provides privacy. This is an entertainer’s dream with a massive Gazebo for summer soirees and the rear covered patio is perfect for sipping your morning coffee while listening to the birds sing all while enjoying spectacular views of the water. This is a beautifully appointed, cedar-clad home set on a meticulously manicured lot with updates including electrical service, freshly paved driveway & exterior paint 2025, three new furnaces & commercial grade seamless gutters 2024, 75 gallon HWT 2023, complete w/yard drainage system & stunning water access.
